title: OptimizeRx and PulsePoint Partner to Connect HCP Media Across the Funnel
summary: OptimizeRx’s latest DSP integration expands buyer access to authenticated point of care inventory through existing programmatic workflows
body_markdown:
**WALTHAM, Mass., October 27, 2026** – OptimizeRx Corp. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: OPRX), a healthcare technology company helping life sciences companies reach and engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and patients at critical decision points, today announced a new partnership with PulsePoint, an award-winning programmatic platform advancing omnichannel healthcare marketing, that will make OptimizeRx’s authenticated electronic health record (EHR) and e-prescribing inventory available to PulsePoint clients.


The integration builds on both companies’ efforts to make HCP media more connected. OptimizeRx is expanding programmatic access to point of care inventory that historically was only purchased through direct or specialized channels, while PulsePoint brings that inventory and 250,000 incremental NPIs into its platform designed to coordinate HCP media activation, optimization, and reporting. Together, the companies are making point of care easier to incorporate into the broader media plan rather than managing it as a separate buy.


**Reducing Fragmentation Across the HCP Media Plan**


The partnership helps close a longstanding gap in omnichannel HCP marketing. Digital HCP media can build awareness and consideration over time. The EHR adds a lower-funnel layer closer to prescribing, delivering relevant information within the clinical workflow. Yet EHR media has historically been planned and purchased separately from other digital channels. By bringing OptimizeRx inventory into PulsePoint, marketers can more easily extend broader HCP campaigns into EHR and e-prescribing workflows within a connected programmatic strategy.


“Omnichannel gets harder when high-value channels live in separate buying environments,” said Stephen Silvestro, CEO of OptimizeRx. “Our work with PulsePoint removes a layer of fragmentation, making it easier for brands and agencies to put point of care to work alongside the rest of their media investments.”


“OptimizeRx extends the scale of in-workflow EHR engagement we can offer clients to fuel their comprehensive omnichannel HCP strategies,” said Keith Matt, Group Vice President of Sales at PulsePoint. “Paired with our broader EHR footprint and real-time activation, optimization, and reporting, clients get more reach, more control, and clearer visibility across every campaign.”


**Extending Programmatic Reach at the Point of Care**


PulsePoint is among the first DSPs to integrate OptimizeRx’s authenticated EHR inventory since OptimizeRx opened its network to programmatic buying in June 2026. The integration will give PulsePoint clients access to incremental NPIs through OptimizeRx’s point of care network and bring PulsePoint’s programmatic EHR reach to[over 1 million NPIs](https://go.pulsepoint.com/electronic-health-record-ehr-advertising) . OptimizeRx’s authenticated EHR inventory is expected to be available to advertisers using PulsePoint in November 2026.


**About OptimizeRx**


OptimizeRx is a leading healthcare technology company that’s redefining how life science brands connect with patients and healthcare providers. Our platform combines innovative AI-driven tools like the Dynamic Audience Activation Platform (DAAP) and Micro-Neighborhood® Targeting (MNT) to deliver timely, relevant, and hyper-local engagement. By bridging the gap between HCP and DTC strategies, we empower brands to create synchronized marketing solutions that drive faster treatment decisions and improved patient outcomes.


Our commitment to privacy-safe, patient-centric technology ensures that every interaction is designed to make a meaningful impact, delivering life-changing therapies to the right patients at the right time. Headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, OptimizeRx partners with some of the world’s leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies to transform the healthcare landscape and create a healthier future for all.


For more information, follow the Company on[X](https://x.com/OPRXtweets) or[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/oprx/) , or visit[www.optimizerx.com](http://www.optimizerx.com/) .


**About PulsePoint**


PulsePoint, a division of Internet Brands, is an award-winning technology company that uses real-world data in real time to optimize campaign performance and revolutionize health decision-making. Leveraging proprietary datasets and methodology, PulsePoint helps brands engage healthcare professionals and consumer populations with an unprecedented level of accuracy to deliver unparalleled results to the clients it serves. For more information, visit[pulsepoint.com](https://www.pulsepoint.com/) .
